design_assistance.corrections: Independent numerical review fixed gain solve dimensions and retained correlated two-fix initialization; synthetic tests and OLS oracle precede new real score.
design_assistance.provider: Grok project static reasoning, not remote execution

failure_policy: Retain every declared group/model/horizon. Failed tracks keep six null outcomes and explicit reasons. Any failed acquired outcome withholds all five common acquired-cohort aggregates and uncertainty fraction ranges.

kalman.covariance_update: Joseph form with symmetry/PSD roundoff checks; no clipping, no future measurement correction.
kalman.forecast_anchor: Filtered last training state; other models use raw last training position.
kalman.gain: Solve S*X=H*P, then K=X.T; never invert innovation covariance.
kalman.initialization: At second observation: p=z1, v=(z1-z0)/dt0, Ppp=rI, Ppv=(r/dt0)I, Pvv=(2r/dt0^2)I. Correct only prefix indices 2 onward.
kalman.initialization_assumptions: Constant first-interval velocity and independent IID isotropic position errors; upstream NOAA interpolation may violate both.
kalman.process_noise: Continuous white acceleration: Q=q*[[dt^3/3*I,dt^2/2*I],[dt^2/2*I,dt*I]]; q units m^2/s^3.
kalman.transition: F=[[I,dt*I],[0,I]] using actual finite interval seconds.

limitations: Already viewed four acquired buoy-days, not unseen independent evidence; two original target slots remain missing.
120 model outcomes reuse only 24 observed intervals and cannot be treated as 120 independent observations.
NOAA hourly QC/interpolation may use future raw fixes upstream. Prefix-only code is not proof of operational real-time independence.
Assumed q/R and IID initialization are uncalibrated, not NOAA measurement-error estimates; state covariance is not a source probability.
No currents/forcing, wall/retention physics, debris identity, reef impact, physical camera/tank validation, provider calls or model promotion.

metrics.ade_m: Mean six great-circle errors then equal-drifter macro mean.
metrics.fde_m: Sixth-hour great-circle error then equal-drifter macro mean.
metrics.uncertainty: For observed-position hits use latent position covariance plus assumed R. Nominal 50% and 90% 2D Gaussian thresholds -2log(0.5), -2log(0.1). Report per-drifter counts/fractions and their range only; no calibrated coverage claim.
metrics.vector_rmse_m_s: Root mean squared local interval displacement residual divided by 3600; predicted first increment begins at each model anchor, observed first increment at raw last prefix point.

purpose: Isolated fixed-noise Kalman motion diagnostic beside four unchanged baselines; no selection, promotion, source inference or physical claims.
truth_gate: Create all 20 complete tracks using prefixes and future time metadata before reading any held-out latitude or longitude. Never update state using future fixes.
